summary: Ceiling prime spec passes all critical doctrine checks. No geometry violations, no UOM mixing, spray/backroll coupling compliant (spray 400 <= backroll 300). Two doctrine gaps flagged as warnings: proposed PaintScope key (PS_META.SF.FLOOR_VACUUM_AREA) not yet in catalog, and proposed site condition (floor_type) not yet in Site_Condition_Vocabulary_Reference. Research corrections RC-001 through RC-004 have pending doctrine assignments — deferred by human decision. Application quality doctrine (v1.2) correctly applied — no tiered application defect tolerance on apply tasks.

human_feedback.notes: Extensive human review throughout pipeline. Major corrections applied: RC-001 (no spot-priming), RC-002 (zero stain blocking on PVA/acrylic), RC-003 (conditional floor protection), RC-004 (no dry times). Additional corrections: product names, roller nap ranges, tape/paper yields, floor protection materials, ceiling holes/insulation concern, QT5 sanding removed from prime scope, backroll rate corrected for porous surface, vacuum rate adjusted, application quality doctrine created and applied.

field_corrections_applied.rationale: NC drywall fasteners are mudded and rust-resistant

field_corrections_applied.correction: RC-002: Zero stain blocking on PVA/acrylic primers
field_corrections_applied.rationale: These are sealers, not stain blockers. Different product category.

field_corrections_applied.correction: RC-003: Conditional floor protection by floor_type
field_corrections_applied.rationale: NC may have finished floors (tile, hardwood) already installed
Too many variables — temperature, humidity, product, ventilation
No Kilz, Zinsser, Glidden — professional contractor spec

field_corrections_applied.correction: Correct product names: SW PVA Primer (QT2-3), SW ProMar 200 (QT4)
field_corrections_applied.rationale: ProMar 400 was incorrect for QT4; ProMar 200 is the right product

field_corrections_applied.correction: Tape yield 180 LF/roll, masking paper 180 LF/roll
field_corrections_applied.rationale: 60 yards = 180 LF per roll for all sizes
Contractor discretion within range, not fixed single nap

field_corrections_applied.correction: Rosin paper default for hard floor protection
field_corrections_applied.rationale: Taped rosin paper is standard for finished hard floors when spraying ceilings

field_corrections_applied.correction: Ceiling openings include open holes (insulation concern)
field_corrections_applied.rationale: In NC, fixtures may not be installed — open holes must be sealed

field_corrections_applied.correction: QT5 sanding removed from prime scope
field_corrections_applied.rationale: Sanding before finish coat belongs to finish spec (SF_DRYWALL_CEILINGS_NC_PAINT)
Ceiling prime masking is fallout protection, not intricate masking

field_corrections_applied.correction: Application quality is universal — no tiered defect acceptance
field_corrections_applied.rationale: Per PCA: properly painted surface at ALL quality tiers. QT varies inspection/sanding/time, not application quality.

field_corrections_applied.correction: Backroll primer rate slower than finish coat backroll
field_corrections_applied.rationale: Porous bare drywall absorbs product, creates more roller drag than sealed surface

field_corrections_applied.correction: Floor vacuum rate set to 1000 SF/hr
field_corrections_applied.rationale: 1500 was too high — adjusted per human input
